claim_policy.exploratory: exploratory localization, not a causal claim
claim_policy.supported: control comparison supports this component as causal for the margin

model.continuation_scoring: sum of all continuation token log-probabilities, no length normalization, no added special tokens

json_prefill.role: primary instrument; protocol v3 output_format.json_prefill, identical for every arm

letters_a_vulnerable.suffix:
Answer with a single letter. A means vulnerable. B means not_vulnerable_for_target.

letters_a_vulnerable.role: label-mapping-swap control: A states the vulnerable verdict

letters_b_vulnerable.suffix:

letters_b_vulnerable.role: label-mapping-swap control: A states the clean verdict

cost.forward_pass_definition: one physical forward through the model per scored continuation
cost.metered_by: UnitMeter in continuation_scores; the causal stage does not go through WspTools, so it is counted here rather than charged to the tool budget

causal.metered_by: UnitMeter (continuation_scores calls it once per physical forward)

cost.forward_pass_definition: one physical batch through the model
cost.note: Only the activation and attention stages are charged to --budget, because they go through WspTools; the causal stage is metered separately and reported here so the total is not silently the activation number.
